findings.note: Row says Class III implantable transition deadline is 2026-05-26, but Reg. 2023/607 sets 2027-12-31 for Class III and IIb implantable; this date is not in the regulation and duplicates the next row's category, so the table is internally contradictory and wrong.

findings.quote: | Class III · Class IIb implantable (특정 제외) | **2027-12-31** |
findings.note: Class III is listed in both the 2026-05-26 and 2027-12-31 rows; the 2026-05-26 row should not exist for Class III (custom-made class III has a separate, later-dated regime).

Document carries two conflicting 'last updated' dates (2026-06-09 vs 2026-04-22). The body's currency claims and the EUDAMED mandatory-use item added in the header (2026-05-28) are not reflected in section 3.3/5, so the body is stale relative to its own changelog.

findings.quote: **Class IIa** (수동 영상 수신) 또는 IIb (시스템 구성품)
findings.note: Section 3.1 states Rule 10's IIa carve-out applies to devices specifically intended for recording X-ray diagnostic images, but section 6 hedges IIa/IIb for the same detector without resolving; also 3.1 calls the IIa reading only 'possible' while section 6 treats it as the primary classification.

PMCF/PSUR are EU MDR concepts; the document mixes them into a global-looking list without KR/US equivalents, and the heading structure risks confusion in KR context (MFDS has no PSUR/PMCF equivalent under that name).

EUDAMED module mandatory-use is triggered by a Commission notice published in the OJ under Reg. 2024/1860, not a 'Commission Decision' numbered this way; citation is unverifiable and likely incorrect.

findings.quote: Form FDA 2579 (Report of Assembly): **2023년 개정(88 FR 3638)으로 일부 부속 컴포넌트 제출 의무 완화**
findings.note: Federal Register citation and the described 2023 amendment of Form 2579 reporting cannot be corroborated and looks mismatched to the claimed change.

Ed 2.0 of IEC 60601-2-54 was published in 2022, but the statement that it fully replaces the 2009 edition plus amendments should be verified; also 'IEC 60601-2-28:2017 (Ed 3.0)' is plausible but unlabeled as to FDA recognition status.
